parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance to which the exchange belongs.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. If this is your first call, or if you have retrieved all results, leave this parameter empty.

parameters.name: VirtualHost
parameters.description: The name of the vhost to which the exchange belongs.
